f1: |cffffd100Tip:|r Your spell casting can be cancelled by moving, jumping or hitting the escape key.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can <Shift>Click on an item to place an item link into a chat message.
|cffffd100Tip:|r All of your action bars can have their hotkeys remapped in the key bindings interface.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Choose your abilities and talents carefully as once your talents are chosen, you must spend gold to unlearn them.
|cffffd100Tip:|r A mail icon next to the minimap means you have new mail.  Visit a mailbox to retrieve it.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can add additional action bars to your game interface from the interface options menu.
|cffffd100Tip:|r If you hold down <Shift> while right-clicking on a target to loot, you will automatically loot all items on the target.
|cffffd100Tip:|r If you enjoyed playing with someone from your realm, put them on your friends list!
|cffffd100Tip:|r There are a number of different loot options when in a group. The group leader can right-click their own portrait to change the options.
|cffffd100Tip:|r If you never want to hear from another player again, you can /ignore them. You can always change your mind later.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Being polite while in a group with others will get you invited back!
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can click on a faction in the reputation pane to get additional information and options about that faction.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can display the duration of beneficial spells on you from the interface options menu.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can lock your action bar so you don't accidentally move spells. This is done using the interface options menu.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can cast a spell on yourself without deselecting your current target by holding down <Alt> while pressing your hotkey.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Killing guards gives no honor.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Typing /macro will bring up the interface to create macros.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Enemy players whose names appear in gray are much lower level than you are and will not give honor when killed.
|cffffd100Tip:|r From the Raid UI you can drag a player to the game field to see their status or drag a class icon to see all members of that class.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can hide your interface with <Alt>Z and take screenshots with <Print Screen>.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can change which buffs or debuffs are displayed on yourself or targets in order to get the information you need.
|cffffd100Tip:|r If you <Shift>Click on a player name in the chat window it tells you additional information about them.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Use the assist button (F key) while targeting another player, and it will target the same target as that player.
|cffffd100Tip:|r <Shift>Clicking on an item being sold by a vendor will let you select how many of that item you wish to purchase.
|cffffd100Tip:|r When you learn a profession or secondary skill the button that allows you to perform that skill is found in the Professions Tab in your Spellbook.
|cffffd100Tip:|r If you are having trouble finding something in a capital city, try asking a guard for directions.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can view messages you previously sent in chat by pressing <Alt> and the up arrow key.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can Shift-Click on an item stack to split it into smaller stacks.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Pressing both mouse buttons simultaneously will make your character run.
|cffffd100Tip:|r When replying to a tell from a player (Default 'R'), the <TAB> key cycles through people you have recently replied to.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can remove a friendly spell enhancement on yourself by right-clicking on the spell effect icon.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Clicking an item name that appears bracketed in chat will tell you more about the item.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can learn all of the secondary skills (fishing, cooking, first-aid and woodcutting).
|cffffd100Tip:|r It's considered polite to talk to someone before inviting them into a group, or opening a trade window.
|cffffd100Tip:|r <Shift>click on a quest in your quest log to toggle quest tracking for that quest.
|cffffd100Tip:|r On Ascension, every Auctionhouse is linked together from BOTH factions.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Ensure that all party members are on the same stage of an escort quest before beginning it.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Your character can eat and drink at the same time.
|cffffd100Tip:|r When interacting with other players a little kindness goes a long way!
|cffffd100Tip:|r You're much less likely to encounter wandering monsters while following a road.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Use the Dungeon Finder tool to quickly travel to dungeons or to find more players for your dungeon group.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Bring your friends to Azeroth, but don't forget to go outside Azeroth with them as well.
|cffffd100Tip:|r If you keep an empty mailbox, the mail icon will let you know when you have new mail waiting!
|cffffd100Tip:|r Never give another player your account information.
|cffffd100Tip:|r When a player not in your group damages a monster before you do, it will display a gray health bar and you will get no loot or experience from killing it.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can see the spell that your current target is casting by turning on the 'Cast Bars' options in the combat interface options tab.

|cffffd100Tip:|r You can access the map either by clicking the map button in the upper right of the mini-map or by hitting the 'M' key. The map can help you locate where you need to go to complete a quest.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Spend your honor points for powerful rewards at the Champion's Hall (Alliance) or Hall of Legends (Horde).
|cffffd100Tip:|r The honor points you earn each day become available immediately. Check the PvP interface to see how many points you have to spend.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Dungeon meeting stones can be used to summon absent party members.  It requires two players at the stone to do a summoning.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Quest items that are in the bank cannot be used to complete quests.
|cffffd100Tip:|r A quest marked as (Failed) in the quest log can be reacquired from the quest giver.
|cffffd100Tip:|r The number next to the quest name in your log is how many other party members are on that quest.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You cannot advance quests other than (Raid) quests while you are in a raid group.
|cffffd100Tip:|r To enter a chat channel, type /join [channel name] and /leave [channel name] to exit.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Mail will be kept for a maximum of 30 days before it disappears.

|cffffd100Tip:|r Once you get a key, they can be found in a special key ring bag that is to the left of your bags.
 Keys are never dropped in High-Risk PvP.

|cffffd100Tip:|r City Guards will often give you directions to other locations of note in the city.
 This includes points of interest exclusive to Ascension!
|cffffd100Tip:|r A group leader can reset their instances or change dungeon difficulty by Right Clicking on their character portrait.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can always get a new hearthstone from any innkeeper.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can open a small map of the current zone either with Shift-M or as an option from the world map.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Players cannot dodge, parry, or block attacks that come from behind them.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can only have one Battle Elixir and one Guardian Elixir on you at a time.
|cffffd100Tip:|r When you are mousing over an item, you can hold down the shift key and it will also show you the item of that type you have equipped.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - You can have up to 10 characters total per realm. You can activate or deactive more to increase this limit by typing .character list in-game.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can reuse text that you have recently typed. Press Enter, then use <Alt> + Up Arrow to scroll through your previous messages.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Your mounts and non-combat companions can be accessed from the Pets tab on your character page.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Currencies, such as the ones collected from Battlegrounds or Heroic dungeons, are stored in the Currency Page.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Completing some Achievements may grant unique non-combat items as rewards.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Items with bonus spell power improve both spell damage and healing.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Dealing damage, healing or casting spells can generate Threat against a creature.  Most creatures will attack the player with the highest Threat against them.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Creatures four levels above you can hit you with a Crushing Blow for extra damage.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can have your hair cut, colored or styled in a Barber Shop located in many cities.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can compare your Achievements to those of another player.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can set a Focus Frame by Right Clicking on a unit frame.  You can unlock a Focus Frame to move it anywhere around your screen.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can set an option to cast spells on yourself or on your Focus target by looking in Interface Options, Combat.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can use the Calendar to see upcoming holidays or plan events with your guild or friends.
|cffffd100Tip:|r If you're looking for something different to do, try to complete some of the more unusual Achievements.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can link quests, items, spells and achievements to chat messages by Shift-Left Clicking in your log.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can track progress on current quests or achievements.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can track many things, such as low-level quests or vendors by clicking on the magnifying glass near your mini map.
|cffffd100Tip:|r A sanctuary is a town in which Player vs. Player combat is prohibited, such as Booty Bay, Shattrath, and Dalaran.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Improving your reputation with a faction can grant access to new quests or items.
|cffffd100Tip:|r The Calendar can tell you when raids reset.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Creatures cannot make critical hits with spells, but players can.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Creatures can dodge attacks from behind, but players cannot.  Neither creatures nor players can parry attacks from behind.

|cffffd100Tip:|r You can use the V key to show enemy name plates above the enemy's head.  Name plates may help you keep track of enemy health or spell casting, or may make it easier to quickly change targets.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can activate the Equipment Manager feature under Interface Controls to let you quickly swap to sets of gear that you find yourself using often.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can enable Arena Enemy Frames to display the unit frames of the enemy team when in Arena matches.
|cffffd100Tip:|r If you press <Alt> while your cursor is over an item slot on your character, you can produce a list of items that can be equipped in that slot.
|cffffd100Tip:|r If an enemy cast bar has a shield icon around it, that means you cannot interrupt the spell with your abilities.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Your guild can schedule Guild Events using the in-game calendar. You choose to sign up for these events rather than waiting for an invitation.
|cffffd100Tip:|r When the autocomplete feature suggests character names, you can use Tab or <Shift> Tab to select a name from the list.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - Always verify that you are accessing the official Ascension website whenever submitting account information.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can download free programs to regularly scan your machine for malicious software including keyloggers.
|cffffd100Tip:|r To avoid account theft, do not login to World of Warcraft on a computer that is shared with the general public. These machines can be infected with malicious software.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Be wary of unofficial sites advertising paid World of Warcraft services. These may contain malicious software that can lead to account theft.
|cffffd100Tip:|r To avoid account theft, do not use browser add-ons or features that allow scripts to be run in the background.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Quest locations and questgivers can be seen on your map.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can earn rewards for running random dungeons using the Dungeon Finder tool. You can go with a group of friends or use Dungeon Finder to find a dungeon group.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - Rumor has it there are Mystical Forges hidden across Azeroth that were used to imbue equipment with powerful enchants.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Uncommon, Rare, and Epic scrolls that are imbued with powerful enchants attached. Seek out a Mystic Altar to extract these enchants for later use!
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - Any Tomes you learn will be added to your collection for future use.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - As you Reforge more items with Enchants, you will learn to store some of your favorites enchants into your collection.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - All end-game dungeon bosses drop Mystic Fragments. You can coalesce these to form Mystic Runes.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - Don't be afraid to try out new playstyles. You never know what you'll uncover.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - Ascension's login screen has synced news from our Twitter. You can see what's going on while you're logging in!
|cffffd100Tip:|r Don't AFK while you're in a Battleground.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - Rare monsters on Ascension grant vastly more experience than normal.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - Mystic Orbs can be found all around the world and in dungeons too!
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - Trainers cannot always teach you the highest ranks. Many abilities have an additional rank you can find from Tomes in the world!
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - You get more stats in your selected allocation each level! You can change your Primary Stat freely as long as you're not in combat!
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can't do damage if you're dead! Try getting more stamina on your gear if you're struggling in PvP.
|cffffd100Tip:|r If you're being outrun in PvP you may need to talent into movement speed!
|cffffd100Tip:|r Mystic Enchants are the quickest path to power on Ascension, seek out mystic altars to imbue your items with powerful enchants.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can change your Risk mode in any Capital City by the Call Boards or in Ratchet at the caravan near the bank!
|cffffd100Tip:|r Stacking skinning knives in your inventory doesn't decrease the chance for you to lose your equipment in High-risk PvP. Sorry!
|cffffd100Tip:|r Wearing better gear in the open world increases your chance of finding higher tier rewards in High-Risk. High-risk, High reward!
|cffffd100Tip:|r Everyone receives a TEMPORARY Volatile Mystic Altar when they reach 60 to experiment with the Mystic Enchanting system. Remember, it is temporary!
|cffffd100Tip:|r Even if you are playing High-Risk, you do not drop items in Battlegrounds, Raids, or Dungeons.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can access your vanity items like the Book of Ascension from the vanity collection! Press 'N' and go to collections and then vanity. Voila!
|cffffd100Tip:|r Items like the Book of Ascension are shared across all characters on the realm you unlocked it. Just go to your character advancement panel and check your vanity collection!
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - When playing in Draft mode, you can use a talent purge to reset every talent that isn't an ability.
|cffffd100Tip:|r On Ascension, professions grant experience. Unlearning a profession incurs a 2 hour cooldown for all profession experience gain.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - Many Mystic Enchants can be applied 3 times, don't forget to extract your favorite enchants to your collection, so you can continue to use them!
|cffffd100Tip:|r Murdering your own faction will eventually make you a criminal, estranging you from your faction. Mercenaries and criminals drop an additional piece of equipment on death.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Entering towns will remove your PvP flag after a few seconds, so long as you aren't engaged in combat! Outlaws do not benefit from this perk.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - Did you know you can search for Mystic Enchants on the auctionhouse? Just type in the name of the Enchant!
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can Transmogrify your items by hitting N, and selecting Wardrobe.
|cffffd100Tip:|r There are Call Boards in every Capital City with rewarding contracts and quests for heroes like you! These Call Boards also list the latest events occuring across Azeroth.

|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - You can save all of your item slots from dropping in High-Risk PvP using Fel Commutation. Fel Commutation protects your items in exchange for gold. Seek out a guard in Stormwind or Orgrimmar for directions!
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - You can utilize Fel Commutation to protect your items in High-Risk PvP in exchange for gold. All slots are automatically commutated for new characters.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - You can access your Ascension Character Advancement by clicking the scroll attached to your minimap or by pressing N on your keyboard.

|cffffd100Tip:|r The transmogrify UI has a feature in them called "sets". You can use this feature to save your currently equipped set, for use of future transmogrification, without costing you any more Runes of Transmogrification or gold!
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can reset Normal, Heroic, and Mythic raids by right clicking on your character portrait!
|cffffd100Tip:|r Mechanics that increase targets vulnerability to your attacks also affect your Pets and Guardians. YES! Improved Stormstrike does benefit your Summoned Imps Fireball and Wild Imps!
|cffffd100Tip:|r Killing grey creatures in dungeons will not grant quest credit.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Critical damage modifiers on Ascension are additive not multiplicative.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Critical damage modifiers on Ascension are additive not multiplicative.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can queue for an endless Manastorm dungeon starting at level 10 in the Dungeon Finder UI (Hotkey:I)

|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - All abilities scale with attack power and spell power, so you can use any combination of abilities and gear you want. Spells still scale better with spell power and vice versa.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - Intellect allocation = caster dps, spirit allocation = healer (does not necessarily mean that you need to stack that stat)
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - To automatically shoot your bow or gun you need to learn the ability Auto Shot in character advancement. (Hotkey:N)

|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - You can Prestige resetting your current specialization and your character to level 1 at Chromie in Capital Cities. This will reset the abilities and talents in your build. Nothing else will be lost.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Critical healing spells heal for 50% more. Critical damage spells deal 75% more damage.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Mail sent from the Auctionhouse and sent from others takes an hour to arrive.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can open your map to see points-of-interests by pressing (Hotkey:M)

|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless Wildcard: You can lock abilities and talents to prevent them from being unlearned in Wildcard Mode by pressing the lock icon next to the ability in the character advancement (Hotkey: N).
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can report a bug found in-game, and make a ticket to talk to a GM in-game, by pressing Escape and selecting Help / Report Bug option!
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can find commonly used addons that work with Ascensions custom spells and items on the Launcher under the addons tab.
|cffffd100Tip:|r On Ascension, Damage Reduction modifiers are multiplicative.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - When Prestiging, you can prestige one specialization at a time. This allows you to keep an old build while leveling a new one.
|cffffd100Tip:|r On Ascension, you can unlock mounts at any mount trainer in Capital Cities regardless of your Character's race.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can redeliver vanity items you own through the vanity collection (Hotkey:N). Navigate to the Vanity tab at the bottom, then find your item and click deliver item.

|cffffd100Tip:|r You can customize your character, change your race, or faction at any time using potions obtained from the Auctionhouse. Customization Potion, Race Change Potion, and Faction Change potion.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - Not sure what you want to build? Great complete builds can be found on the Hero Architect. (Hotkey:N) Navigate to the Hero Architect at the bottom.

|cffffd100Tip:|r You can unlock Conquest of Azeroth and the Wrath of the Lich King alpha with the Conquest of Azeroth Travel Guide and the Northrend Travel Guide in-game item from the auctionhouse or shop.
|cffffd100Tip:|r On Ascension, All raids scale to the number of raiders between 10 and 25, bringing more players increases the total amount of loot.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can earn loyalty points by verifying your email, adding 2FA, and other activities on the userpanel of the website.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Heirlooms can be acquired with Marks of Ascension from Nozdormu in capital Cities, Tokens of Prestige from Chromie, or on our Online Store.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Seasonal Points can only be spent on Seasonal Realms after using the Seasonal Achievements Unlock.
|cffffd100Tip:|r If you are having trouble creating a ticket in-game try reaching out to us on discord!
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can rank up your Spells at specific Class Trainers or at a Book of Ascension.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can customize your shapeshift forms with Incarnations found on the Auctionhouse and the Bazaar.
|cffffd100Tip:|r You can unlock additional profession slots with the Craftsman's Codex, from the Nozdormu in capital cities, the auction house, or our online store.
|cffffd100Tip:|r On Ascension, you can unlock all primary professions on one character using the Craftsman Codex.
|cffffd100Tip:|r Classless - You can buy Mystic Enchant Scrolls to empower your character on the Auctionhouse.
|cffffd100Tip:|r When doing Manastorms you will unlock a checkpoint every 5 levels.
|cffffd100Tip:|r PvE and PvP power activate at max level giving you additional power.
